title: Rename user name field to displayName across files
prompt:
Refactor request: rename the public JSON field `name` to `displayName` for users across this multi-file service.

Scope:
- The User type / shape should expose `displayName` instead of `name`.
- Seed data, services, middleware, routes, and tests that refer to the user display field must use `displayName`.
- GET /users and GET /users/:id responses must serialize `displayName` (e.g. Alice, Bob), not `name`.
- Post routes and types are out of scope except where they accidentally import User fields.
- Keep handleRequest(method, path) → string (sync JSON strings).
- After the rename, `bun test` must be fully green. Update tests as part of the refactor so they assert `displayName`.

Do not leave the old public field `name` on user objects in source or responses.
